__readme: AV device catalog for the Room Config Builder: connectors, rack height, estimated power draw and unit price per model. Edited on the Device Editor tab; entries here override the app's built-in models.

devices.notes: Assisted listening transmitter. Gets the same audio tie as the program feed on every source change, from the switcher output named in SYSTEM_SETUP output_audio_ald.
Room Blu-ray player, reached on the switcher input named by SYSTEM_SETUP input_blu_ray.
The room's ceiling speaker run, drawn as one load. What drives it is the amplifier in the switcher (an SA or MA build) or a separate amp fed from the DSP.
The lectern monitor an instructor watches instead of turning round. Fed by the switcher output named in SYSTEM_SETUP output_monitor_1 (and _2 for a second one).
Room DVD player, reached on the switcher input named by SYSTEM_SETUP input_dvd.
Small-form-factor room PC (a 1L micro/mini desktop), mounted behind the display or under the table. Two display outputs, so it can drive a confidence monitor as well.

A laptop on the room's USB-C plate - one lead carrying picture, USB for the room's camera and mic, and charge. Which of USB-C and VGA a room has is SYSTEM_SETUP gui_usb_or_vga; both land on the same switcher input, input_usb.
Powered - set its watts on the catalog entry
